flaws.locator: Theorem 4.6 (Section 4, Character Sums on Curves), statement: the hypothesis 'Suppose Tr_{F_{q^d}/F_q}(g) = sum_{i=0}^{d-1} sigma^i(g) is not of the form r(t)^q - r(t) in F(t)' (v2), where v3 requires 'not of the form r(t)^p - r(t)'; the conclusion (the bound (d(D_1+D_3+D_4)+D_2-1) sqrt(q) on the incomplete sum) is unchanged

Theorem 4.6, proof, the sentence 'Since Tr_{F_{q^d}/F_q}(g) is not of the form r(t)^q - r(t) in F(t), the sheaf L_{psi, Tr(g)} is geometrically nonconstant, and it has wild ramification at poles of Tr(g)': the criterion for geometric nonconstancy of the Artin-Schreier sheaf is applied with the weaker form, every r^q - r being of the form s^p - s (s = r + r^p + ... + r^{q/p}) but not conversely
